notes.title: Elite Exorcist Miko now available in Early Access!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950031/b7134a50b6ae51de4ad55c591f84fb7435069792.png[/img]

My current [i]hololive[/i] game project, [b][i]Elite Exorcist Miko[/i][/b], is now available for purchase in Early Access! Similarly to [i]WOWOWOW KORONE BOX[/i], [i]Elite Exorcist Miko[/i] is a twin stick bullet hell shooter. However, the focus is now on a huge variety of boss battles, having you challenge [i]hololive[/i] members in Touhou-style duels and collecting materials to create equipment and become stronger! If you enjoyed [i]WOWOWOW KORONE BOX[/i], I think you'll do very well in [i]Elite Exorcist Miko[/i]!

As a bonus for [i]WOWOWOW KORONE BOX[/i] players, those of you who have collected a total of at least [b]50 Korone Boxes[/b] here will receive the [b]Bonkhammer[/b] in [i]Elite Exorcist Miko[/i]; an equipment item that will allow you to easily send enemies flying as projectiles, just like you're used to! This promo will always be available, so do check out the new game if you're interested!

notes.content:

notes.title: v1.2.3 Update + Information for returning players
notes.content:
Firstly, thank you to everyone playing [i]WOWOWOW KORONE BOX[/i], whether you're a returning player or trying the game for the first time!

The Steam release contains various changes to improve the player experience:
[list]
[*]Key rebinding
[*]Improved weapon unlock process
[*]Several weapons have additional alternate fire effects. Try using Fire 2 to find them!
[*]Steam Achievements
[*]Integration with Steam Leaderboards
[*]Improved Japanese localization
[*]Bug fixes and miscellaneous improvements
[/list]
Information for returning players:
[list]
[*]Unfortunately, save data from the itch.io versions will not carry over to this one. This is due to changes to the save format to support unique save data between Steam accounts.
[*]A Mac build is currently not possible. Apologies for the inconvenience.
[/list]
